title: Black-Box Opinion Manipulation Attacks to Retrieval-Augmented Generation of Large Language Models
reasoning: The paper focuses on adversarial attacks to manipulate the opinions generated by RAG systems. While it discusses the social and ethical implications of such manipulation and utilizes controversial topics (like abortion) in its test cases, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/ethical frameworks. It also contains a standard 'Ethical Statement' section which is excluded by the prompt's criteria.
